event: UKMTO issues at least one new advisory for a fifth tanker strike or near-miss in the Strait of Hormuz
basis: three or four prior incidents in 48 hours
watch_for: next gCaptain or shipping X post confirming fresh hit
wrong_if: no new incident reported by 06 Oct 2026 2359 UTC

event: Ukrainian sources release satellite or drone imagery of at least one additional Russian airbase strike beyond Khanskaya
watch_for: Ukrainska Pravda or Militarnyi post with new imagery
wrong_if: no new base strike imagery released by 06 Oct 2026 2359 UTC

event: Houthi forces publicly claim and show evidence of a missile or drone strike on Saudi-backed positions near Dhubab or Bab el-Mandeb
watch_for: Houthi statement or video on X or Telegram
wrong_if: no verified Houthi claim or strike evidence by 08 Oct 2026 2359 UTC

event: Eritrean government issues statement accusing Ethiopia of border violations or airstrikes near Tigray
watch_for: Asmara foreign ministry or state media release
wrong_if: no Eritrean accusation by 08 Oct 2026 2359 UTC

event: Russian forces strike Kyiv's Northern Bridge for a fifth consecutive day
watch_for: Kyiv Independent or local X reports of new drone activity
wrong_if: no strike reported on 06 or 07 Oct 2026

event: At least two additional Hormuz tanker incidents trigger a 15%+ spike in regional war-risk insurance premiums
watch_for: Lloyd's or broker advisory on rate changes
wrong_if: no premium spike reported by 13 Oct 2026

event: CISA or equivalent adds at least one new critical infrastructure victim of SharePoint CVE-2026-65660 exploitation
basis: active Warlock actor targeting of water/telecom
watch_for: CISA KEV update or utility outage report
wrong_if: no new confirmed victim by 13 Oct 2026

event: TPLF leadership publicly claims ongoing control of territory outside Mekelle or launches counter-attack
basis: withdrawal from capital but strikes persist
wrong_if: no TPLF claim or counter-attack by 13 Oct 2026

event: Taiwan MND reports a single-day total of 9 or more PLA aircraft crossing the median line
wrong_if: no day exceeds 8 crossings by 13 Oct 2026
